title: Case II: The Sibling of the DB is Red

blocks.content: Case II: The Sibling of the DB is Red

items: Swap the color of the parent and sibling.
Rotate in the direction of the DB.

blocks.content: Suppose we have the following double black node:

blocks.alt: Sibling of Double Black Node is Red

blocks.content: Since its sibling is red, we swap the color of the parent and sibling and rotate in the direction of the DB.

blocks.alt: Swap Color of Parent and Sibling and Rotate in the Direction of DB

blocks.content: This new tree will be treated as a new DB problem and we will check for all cases again.
